Create one native pixel-art speech-mouth atlas for the SAME original 64x29 lower-face crop shown in the sole reference image. Reference role: exact prepared source mouth grid, repeated source crop for alignment and palette. Intended use: Daggerfall Unity portrait mouth atlas. Preserve the source woman's identity, restrained skeptical expression, pixel scale, muted colors and original lower-face framing.

Canvas layout: exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, nine equal 64x29 cells, total aspect ratio 64:29, no gutters, labels, borders or extra rows. Row-major order A B C / D E F / G H X. Each cell is the complete lower 64x29 crop at source scale. Keep hair, cheeks and skin outside the mouth feature area identical to the source. Keep movement confined to the mouth region around source x22..42, y40..50; no neck or chin band.

Use the complete Rhubarb mouth meanings:
A: pressured closed lips for P/B/M, subtle natural lip contact.
B: narrow opening with upper and lower teeth nearly together for consonants and EE.
C: medium unrounded opening for EH/AE.
D: wide open AA, widest vertical opening.
E: slightly rounded AO/ER, no wider than C.
F: puckered rounded lips for UW/OW/W.
G: upper teeth touch lower lip for F/V.
H: tongue raised behind upper teeth for L, opening between C and D.
X: relaxed closed idle mouth.

Make the guarded emotion understated: mild lip tension and reserved, questioning composure; no smile, sneer, exaggerated frown or open-mouth anger. Keep source-like muted terracotta lip hue, soft natural shading and complete lip edges. When teeth show, use subdued neutral gray-ivory clearly distinct from skin, never bright white or shiny. Use modest mouth-cavity contrast. Preserve natural small teeth and tongue at native resolution. Do not alter nose, face shape, cheeks, hair or shadows. No lip ring, lipstick, captions or stylized vector outlines.
